newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Railcorp February carloadings up.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Railcorp February carloadings up.

text.p: Pioneer Railcorp said Wednesday it shipped 2,755 carloadings in February, up 36 percent from the 2,029 shipped in the same month a year ago.
Four railroads acquired by Pioneer during the past 12 months generated 42 percent of the February carloadings total, the company said in a statement.

Guy Brenkman, Pioneer's chairman and chief executive officer, said that other Pioneer lines, notably the Fort Smith Railroad, performed well while some others continued to be plagued by heavy snow, flooding and shipping reductions by a few Pioneer grain and steel customers.
Pioneer operates 15 freight short line railroads with over 500 miles of track in seven eastern, southern and midwestern states. The company owns almost 1,000 rail cars and locomotives.
